اغتفرتا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَفَرَتَا (iḡtafaratā) /iɣ.ta.fa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# اُغْتُفِرَتَا (uḡtufiratā) /uɣ.tu.fi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
